name: changeable-pricing-section
title: Changeable Pricing Section
description: A compact pricing card listing three plans as radio rows. A Monthly/Yearly switch springs across, prices roll, and the chosen plan expands to show its feature list.
use: A signup flow needs a compact plan chooser with billing period and inline feature detail.
avoid: Prices are strings supplied per plan, so discounts and currency maths must be computed outside.
a11y: Plan rows are clickable divs with no radio role or keyboard focus, and the toggle has no aria-pressed state. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded panel holds a Select a plan heading, a small segmented Monthly/Yearly switch and three stacked plan rows. Each row has a radio dot, plan name, description and a right-aligned price.
behaves: Clicking the switch slides an orange pill and rolls each price to the other billing period. Selecting a plan fills its radio, tints its border orange and unfolds a dashed-top list of features inside that row.
customise: Plans arrive as an array with monthly and yearly price strings, features and badges; title, labels, footer and button text are props.
weight: light: A few plan rows with layout and price animations; no animation loop.
demo: Plans Starter, Team and Enterprise priced $12, $29 and $79 monthly with a Popular badge on Team.
issues: Plan rows are clickable divs, so keyboard users cannot change the selected plan.
polishWhy: Neat dark plan picker with a springy toggle and a tidy feature reveal.
